name: Elminster’s Effulgent Spheres

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/frhof/magic-of-faerun.  Reference entry; bespoke effects require manual resolution. Artificer is omitted where listed because that class is not available in this game.

summary: Reference-only: Six orbiting spheres can be spent individually. Reaction to Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage: resist that type until your next turn starts. Bonus Action: ranged spell attack within 120 feet for 3d6 of one of those types, spending the sphere hit or miss. Ends when all spheres are spent. Gain one more sphere per slot above 6.
